purpose: Reconstructed 130-case regression matrix with independently calculated expected tax amounts. This is a new suite, not a recovered copy of the missing historical 130+ rows.
historicalDataRecovery: The original historical rows remain unavailable; prior conversation only confirms an aggregate 126-pass report and unresolved LT-127. These new cases are explicitly separate.
formulaBasis: Land value increment tax progressive tiers, holding-period reductions (20/30/40 years), urban/non-urban self-use area limits, and prior-land-tax-credit cap at 5% of calculated tax.
